chunks: “That on the Day of Jumu‘ah, it causes leprosy.”

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; a report transmitted without a full sanad/isnad here
key_terms.يَوْمِ: day; referring here to a specific time

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about using depilatory paste on Friday?
ai.summary: This report states that using it on the day of Jumu‘ah leads to leprosy. It appears in the context of guidance related to cleanliness, grooming, and the etiquette connected with Jumu‘ah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.267 – (Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Farisi Al-Fattal narrates from The Messenger of Allah (sw) ):
“Applying Nuura (depilatory paste) on Jumu’ah, it is said that it can lead to leprosy."
